description: OpenUI let's you describe UI using your imagination, then see it rendered live.

summary.one_liner: OpenUI is an open-source tool where you describe a UI in plain language, see it rendered live, and ask for changes or convert HTML into other frameworks.
use_cases: Prototype UI components by describing them in natural language
Convert HTML into React, Svelte, or Web Components
Test different LLM models for UI generation
Run a self-hosted v0-style UI generator locally
Use local Ollama models for UI generation
how_to_run: docker run --rm --name openui -p 7878:7878 -e OPENAI_API_KEY -e ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -e OLLAMA_HOST= ghcr.io/wandb/openui
notable: Supports OpenAI, Groq, Gemini, Anthropic, Cohere, Mistral, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint via LiteLLM
Live rendering of generated UI as you iterate
Custom LiteLLM proxy config can override auto-generated config
Dev container and Codespaces setup provided
Ships as a Docker image on ghcr.io
caveats: Docker Compose with Ollama is described as likely very slow; GPU or native Ollama on Mac recommended
Codespace use with Ollama needs at least 16GB RAM
README describes the project as less polished than v0
